# dir and sub info
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
codes_dir = paste(gitrepo_path, "codes", sep = "/")
fit_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"fits", sep = "/")
figure_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"figures", sep = "/")
```

# load behavior data
```{r}
all_trials_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, "all_trials_brains.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
all_trials_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$missed == 0, ]

indiv_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "participant_check.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)  %>%
  mutate(age_bi = case_when(age <= 36 ~ "younger",
                            age > 36 ~ "older"))

all_trials_df = merge(all_trials_df, indiv_df, by.x = "subjID", by.y = "participant_id")

L3_47_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "participant_L3_47.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

sublist_final = L3_47_df %>% dplyr::select(subjID)

all_trials_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$subjID %in% sublist_final$subjID,] 

all_trials_df = all_trials_df %>% 
  mutate(ingroup = relevel(as.factor(ingroup), ref = "0"),
         human = relevel(as.factor(human), ref = "0"),
         age_bi = relevel(as.factor(age_bi), ref = "younger"),
         block_fair = relevel(as.factor(block_fair), ref = "0"),
         accept = relevel(as.factor(accept), ref = "0")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, offer, accept, human, ingroup, block_fair, age_bi, missed)

all_trials_human_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$human == 1,]

```

# sensitivity
## similar vs dissimilar
### ingroup
```{r}
## ingroup offer sensitivity
ingroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 1,]
ingroup_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                 data = ingroup_df, 
                 family = binomial)
summary(ingroup_mlm)

# ingroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 1,]
# ingroup_mlm_2 = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer||subjID), 
#                  data = ingroup_df, 
#                  family = binomial)
# summary(ingroup_mlm_2)
# anova(ingroup_mlm_1, ingroup_mlm_2, refit = F)

ingroup_fixed_effects <- fixef(ingroup_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

ingroup_random_effects <- ranef(ingroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

ingroup_indiv_effects = ingroup_random_effects[ingroup_random_effects$term == "offer",] %>% 
  mutate(ingroup_rand = condval,
         ingroup_fixed_rand = 
           condval + ingroup_fixed_effects$.[ingroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"],
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, ingroup_rand, ingroup_fixed_rand)
```

### outgroup
```{r}
## outgroup offer sensitivity
outgroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 0,]
outgroup_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                    data = outgroup_df, 
                    family = binomial)
summary(outgroup_mlm)

outgroup_fixed_effects <- fixef(outgroup_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

outgroup_random_effects <- ranef(outgroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

outgroup_indiv_effects = outgroup_random_effects[outgroup_random_effects$term == "offer",] %>% 
  mutate(outgroup_rand = condval,
         outgroup_fixed_rand = 
           condval + outgroup_fixed_effects$.[outgroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"],
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, outgroup_rand, outgroup_fixed_rand)
```
### in vs out
```{r}
## in-out
in_out_rand_df = merge(ingroup_indiv_effects, outgroup_indiv_effects, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(in_out_indiv_logit = ingroup_fixed_rand - outgroup_fixed_rand) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, ingroup_fixed_rand, outgroup_fixed_rand, in_out_indiv_logit)
```

## social vs non-social
### computer
```{r}
## computer offer sensitivity
computer_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$human == 0,] # create computer only df
computer_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                     data = computer_df, 
                     family = binomial)
summary(computer_mlm)

# computer_mlm_1 = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer||subjID), 
#                      data = computer_df, 
#                      family = binomial)
# summary(computer_mlm_1)
# 
# anova(computer_mlm, computer_mlm_1, refit = F)

computer_fixed_effects <- fixef(computer_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

computer_random_effects <- ranef(computer_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

computer_indiv_effects = computer_random_effects[computer_random_effects$term == "offer",] %>% 
  mutate(computer_random = condval,
         computer_fixed_rand = 
           condval + computer_fixed_effects$.[computer_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"],
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, computer_random, computer_fixed_rand)
```

### all human
```{r}
## human offer sensitivity
human_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$human == 1,] # create human only df
human_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                     data = human_df, 
                     family = binomial)
summary(human_mlm)

# human_mlm_1 = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer||subjID), 
#                      data = human_df, 
#                      family = binomial)
# summary(human_mlm_1)
# 
# anova(human_mlm, human_mlm_1, refit = F)

human_fixed_effects <- fixef(human_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

human_random_effects <- ranef(human_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

human_indiv_effects = human_random_effects[human_random_effects$term == "offer",] %>% 
  mutate(human_random = condval,
         human_fixed_rand = 
           condval + human_fixed_effects$.[human_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"],
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, human_random, human_fixed_rand)
```

### soc vs nonsoc
```{r}
## soc-nonsoc
soc_nonsoc_indiv_df = merge(computer_indiv_effects, human_indiv_effects, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(soc_nonsoc_indiv_logit = human_fixed_rand - computer_fixed_rand) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, human_fixed_rand, computer_fixed_rand, soc_nonsoc_indiv_logit)
```

# in_out_sens_df for L3 w/ cov
```{r}
## random sensitivity only
in_out_sens_df = in_out_rand_df %>% merge(., L3_47_df, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(in_out_demean = in_out_rand_logit - mean(in_out_rand_logit),
         in_out_young = in_out_demean*younger,
         in_out_old = in_out_demean*older,
         ones = 1)
write.csv(in_out_sens_df, paste(data_dir, "in_out_sensitivity_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)

in_out_sens_df = in_out_sens_df %>% 
  select(subjID, ones, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         younger, older,
         in_out_young, in_out_old)
write.csv(in_out_sens_df, paste(data_dir, "L3_cov_in_out_sensitivity_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## full slope, rand + fixed
in_out_sens_df = in_out_rand_df %>% merge(., L3_47_df, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(in_out_demean = in_out_full_logit - mean(in_out_full_logit),
         in_out_young = in_out_demean*younger,
         in_out_old = in_out_demean*older,
         ones = 1)
write.csv(in_out_sens_df, paste(data_dir, "in_out_sensitivity_full_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)

in_out_sens_df = in_out_sens_df %>% 
  select(subjID, ones, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         younger, older,
         in_out_young, in_out_old)
write.csv(in_out_sens_df, paste(data_dir, "L3_cov_in_out_sensitivity_full_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
